what.text: This page follows refugees from Cambodia living in Thailand, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 297 Cambodian refugees in Thailand, 2.6% of all refugees from Cambodia.
France hosts the most Cambodian refugees, followed by Thailand, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Cambodia from 1970 to 1975 and from 1978 to 1998, with the KR among the opponents.
It also records interstate armed conflicts between Cambodia and Vietnam from 1975 to 1977 and between Cambodia and Thailand in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1975 at 18830 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 147400, at the end of 1980; the main years of displacement in the data are 1980 to 1982.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Thailand.
These are year-end totals for Thailand only, reported to UNHCR.
